agent.result_text:
A person's backing now works as requested, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**What it is now:** backing adds up the figures of the patrons' SETTLED claims dated within the 90 days up to and including the sheet's today. Each claim counts at the figure fixed when it was settled, so a later rate change doesn't move it. With no such claims, backing shows 0.00. The window starts 89 days before today, so on 2026-03-10 it covers 2025-12-11 through 2026-03-10.

**Where:** the change is in one place, `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. The `backings` calculation now uses a new helper, `recentSettledCentsOf`, and I updated the file's header comment to match. No server or stored-data changes were needed, because backing was only ever worked out on the front end and isn't written to the audit file.

**Decisions for you:**
- **Cap:** backing used to add up the patrons' due-totals after the sheet's cap was applied. The new rule doesn't mention a cap, so backing is no longer capped.
- **Claims settled without a rate:** these have no fixed figure. I count them at the due they currently show, and skip them if that is n/a.

The tests don't exercise either case, so say if you want them handled differently.
